resources.string: Record only work already done here. Plan future activity in Calendar; it will not count as actual time spent.
That time has not occurred yet. Actual work must start and end no later than now. Use Calendar planning for future activity.
The end must be after the start and the duration must be positive. For overnight work, explicitly select an end on the next day.
A single actual-work record cannot exceed 24 hours. Split the period into separate records.
Check the time in HH:MM format and the duration in minutes.
Describe what you did or choose a task.
This record can no longer be edited. Close the form and reopen the current history record.
The linked task is no longer available. Select another task or an unlinked activity.
